Game Overview

In Escape Noob, the core idea is straightforward: dodge dangers and outsmart your ominous clone and bear companion in Escape Noob. Navigate tricky levels, collect hidden gold coins, and strategically find the key to activate barriers. Use quick reflexes and clever tactics to ensure your survival and make a thrilling escape.
